function.name: search_users
function.description: Search the user directory by name or email fragment.

query.description: Name or email fragment to match, case-insensitive.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return. Defaults to 10.

users.description: Matching users, each with user_id, name and email.

function.name: get_user
function.description: Retrieve a single user's profile by user id.

api_list.constraints: Returns an error when no user has the given id.

function.name: create_ticket
function.description: Open a new support ticket for a user.

reporter_id.description: User id of the person reporting the issue.

title.description: Short one-line summary of the issue.

ticket_id.description: Identifier of the newly created ticket.

api_list.constraints: The title must be non-empty. The reporter_id must refer to an existing user. Priority defaults to 'medium' when omitted.

function.name: get_ticket
function.description: Retrieve the full record of a ticket by id.

status.description: One of open, assigned, resolved or closed.

assignee_id.description: User id of the assignee, or null when unassigned.

comments.description: Comments on the ticket, newest last.

function.name: assign_ticket
function.description: Assign an open ticket to an agent.

ticket_id.description: Identifier of the ticket to assign.

assignee_id.description: User id of the agent taking the ticket.
User id now responsible for the ticket.

api_list.constraints: Only a ticket in status 'open' or 'assigned' can be assigned. Assigning a resolved or closed ticket returns an error.

function.name: add_comment
function.description: Append a comment to an existing ticket.

author_id.description: User id of the comment author.

ticket_id.description: Ticket the comment was added to.

function.name: resolve_ticket
function.description: Mark a ticket as resolved with a resolution note.

ticket_id.description: Identifier of the ticket to resolve.

resolution.description: Explanation of how the issue was resolved.

api_list.constraints: A ticket must be assigned before it can be resolved.

function.name: list_tickets
function.description: List tickets, optionally filtered by status or assignee.

status.description: Only return tickets in this status.

assignee_id.description: Only return tickets assigned to this user id.

limit.description: Maximum number of tickets to return. Defaults to 20.

policy_rules:
You are a hotel booking assistant. Follow these rules without exception.
1. Always verify the guest's identity with get_guest_profile before reading or modifying any reservation.
2. Never quote a room as available without first calling search_rooms for the requested dates.
3. A reservation may only be cancelled when its cancellation deadline has not passed. Check with get_reservation before calling cancel_reservation.
4. Never apply a loyalty discount without first confirming the guest's tier with get_loyalty_status.
5. Confirm the total price with the guest before calling create_reservation.

function.name: get_guest_profile
function.description: Look up a guest profile by email address.

email.description: Email address the guest booked with.

api_list.constraints: Returns an error when no guest is registered with that email.

function.name: get_loyalty_status
function.description: Retrieve a guest's loyalty tier and point balance.

tier.description: One of none, silver, gold or platinum.

discount_percent.description: Discount this tier entitles the guest to.

function.name: search_rooms
function.description: Find rooms available at a property for a date range.

room_type.description: Restrict results to a room type.

rooms.description: Available rooms with room_id, type and nightly_rate.

api_list.constraints: check_out must be strictly after check_in. Guests defaults to 1.

function.name: get_room_details
function.description: Retrieve full details and amenities for one room.

nightly_rate.description: Nightly rate before tax and discounts.

function.name: quote_price
function.description: Calculate the total price for a stay, including any discount.

room_id.description: Identifier of the room to price.

discount_percent.description: Loyalty discount to apply, as a percentage.

nights.description: Number of nights in the stay.

function.name: create_reservation
function.description: Book a room for a guest over a date range.

room_id.description: Identifier of the room to book.

cancellation_deadline.description: ISO-8601 date after which cancellation is not permitted.

api_list.constraints: The room must still be available for the whole range. The guest count must not exceed the room's max_guests.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Retrieve a reservation by its identifier.

status.description: One of confirmed, cancelled or completed.

cancellation_deadline.description: Date after which cancellation is not permitted.

function.name: modify_reservation
function.description: Change the dates or guest count of a reservation.

reservation_id.description: Identifier of the reservation to change.

api_list.constraints: Only a reservation in status 'confirmed' can be modified. The room must be available for the new dates.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed reservation.

reservation_id.description: Identifier of the reservation to cancel.

reason.description: Reason the guest gave for cancelling.

api_list.constraints: Cancellation is only permitted before the cancellation_deadline. Cancelling afterwards returns an error and no refund.

function.name: list_reservations
function.description: List a guest's reservations, newest first.

status.description: Only return reservations in this status.

function.name: search_products
function.description: Search the catalog by keyword, with optional filters.

category.description: Restrict results to this product category.

max_price.description: Only return products at or below this price.

in_stock_only.description: When true, exclude products with no stock.

products.description: Matching products with product_id, name and price.

function.name: get_product
function.description: Retrieve full details for one product.

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Check available stock for a product at a warehouse.

warehouse_id.description: Warehouse to check. Defaults to the nearest one.

function.name: create_cart
function.description: Create an empty shopping cart for a customer.

function.name: add_to_cart
function.description: Add a quantity of a product to a cart.

product_id.description: Identifier of the product to add.

api_list.constraints: Quantity must be at least 1 and must not exceed available stock.

function.name: remove_from_cart
function.description: Remove a product from a cart entirely.

product_id.description: Identifier of the product to remove.

function.name: get_cart
function.description: Retrieve the current contents and totals of a cart.

items.description: Cart items with product_id, quantity and line_total.

item_count.description: Total number of units in the cart.

function.name: apply_coupon
function.description: Apply a discount coupon to a cart.

api_list.constraints: The coupon must exist and must not be expired. Only one coupon may be active on a cart at a time.

function.name: get_shipping_options
function.description: List shipping options and costs for a cart and address.

options.description: Shipping options with option_id, carrier, cost and eta_days.

function.name: place_order
function.description: Convert a cart into a confirmed order.

cart_id.description: Identifier of the cart to check out.

api_list.constraints: The cart must contain at least one item and every item must still be in stock. The cart is emptied once the order is placed.

function.name: get_order
function.description: Retrieve an order by its identifier.

status.description: One of confirmed, shipped, delivered or cancelled.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number once shipped, else null.

function.name: track_shipment
function.description: Get the current tracking status of a shipped order.

order_id.description: Identifier of the order to track.

api_list.constraints: Returns an error when the order has not shipped yet.

function.name: request_return
function.description: Open a return request for a delivered order.

order_id.description: Identifier of the order to return.

api_list.constraints: Only a delivered order may be returned, and only within 30 days of delivery.
